# CalcFuel

> CalcFuel helps people make better real-world transport and trip-cost decisions by calculating fuel, range, time and operating costs.

Fuel calculation is the product domain. Marine and towing are authority wedges. Calculators are decision mechanisms, not a generic directory.

## Flagship tools

- [Boat Trip Fuel Planner](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/boat-fuel-calculator): Marine fuel, cost, time, safe range and speed scenarios.
- [Towing Fuel Cost](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/towing-fuel-cost-calculator): Extra fuel cost when towing trailers or caravans.
- [Trip Fuel Cost](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/trip-fuel-cost-calculator): Road trip, return, commute and carpool modes.
- [Drive vs Fly](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/drive-vs-fly-calculator): Total trip cost comparison.
- [Fuel Budget Planner](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/fuel-budget-planner): Weekly/monthly/annual household fuel spend.
- [Motorcycle Fuel Cost](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/motorcycle-fuel-cost-calculator): Ride and commute fuel with bike presets.
- [Fuel Economy & Consumption](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/fuel-economy-savings-calculator): MPG ↔ L/100km and improvement savings.
- [Hybrid vs Petrol](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/hybrid-vs-gas-calculator): Running-cost break-even.
- [EV vs Petrol](https://calcfuel.com/calculators/ev-vs-gas-calculator): Multi-year energy and ownership cost.
